sketchMechanisms: The __del__ destructor is not guaranteed to be called, and even when it is, the object cannot prevent its own garbage collection.
In Lua, tables use weak references via __mode; objects in a weak table vanish silently when no other reference holds them.
In Elixir, a process that is linked to another via Process.link will die when the other dies — unless it traps exits, in which case death arrives as a message instead.
